purpose: The compiled deployments the C2 audit binds each design-point cell to, keyed by the base capability record each was lowered against and selected within that key by model id.  build/ is gitignored, so the bundles themselves are NOT versioned and a digest here is the only thing that makes an audit result reproducible: tools/derive_cycle_machine.py _bind_shipped_deployment refuses a root whose deployment.json carries a different deployment_sha256 with status 'not the registered deployment', and refuses one lowered against a different capability with 'bound to a different capability'.  Both refusals make the cell NOT COMPARABLE, which gate C2 reads as a failure.  This file exists so that the pins are reviewable in a diff instead of buried in a Python literal.

pin_kinds.frozen_evidence: A byte-identical historical snapshot.  Committed evidence artifacts name THIS digest, so re-pointing the pin at a fresh lowering would orphan that evidence and is a defect, not an update.  The registration is expected NOT to reproduce from current source; 'reproduces_from_source_at' names the last commit at which it did, and 'current_source_deployment_sha256' records what current source produces instead.  Refreshing one requires re-running every artifact in 'evidence' in the same change.
pin_kinds.live: A pin meant to track current source.  The build command must reproduce the digest at HEAD, and a divergence is a stale-artifact defect to fix by rebuilding, not by re-pinning.  No registration is currently of this kind.

registrations.why_frozen: aae304e re-derived SCHEDULE tile_rows from the operand surface instead of the loop trip and moved this bundle's KV-scatter descriptors from tile_rows 512 to 66,048; the three evidence artifacts below were produced before it and name the pinned digest.  Re-pointing this registration without re-running all three would leave the audit citing evidence about a bundle that no longer exists.
evidence: commit b7441e8 (AM-E9 v2: one activation-buffer placement, one bank_mask)

registrations.why_frozen: The ROM half of this pair is frozen, and a C2 cell compares the two halves against each other.  aae304e moved this bundle's KV-scatter tile_rows 512 -> 66,048 symmetrically with the ROM side, so refreshing one half alone would compare a post-aae304e lowering against a pre-aae304e one.  The pair moves together or not at all.
evidence: commit b7441e8 (AM-E9 v2: one activation-buffer placement, one bank_mask)

registrations.why_frozen: Two later commits moved this lowering: aae304e (SCHEDULE tile_rows from the operand surface: 3,159 -> 3,165 descriptors) and 4f390b9 (the array token block is 512, which moves max_retired_work 4,206,473 -> 6,655,369).  results/abi3/rom_schedule_checks_deepseek_e9.json names the pinned digest and was produced before both.
evidence: commit 6b41a53 (the DeepSeek Flash pair re-lowered under AM-E9 v2)

registrations.why_frozen: aae304e moved this bundle from 3,305 to 3,341 descriptors (its SCHEDULE count 45 -> 81).  Its ROM twin is frozen for the same reason and a C2 cell compares the two, so the pair moves together or not at all.  results/abi3/hbm_deepseek_e9_deployment_certificate.json names the pinned digest.
evidence: commit 6b41a53 (the DeepSeek Flash pair re-lowered under AM-E9 v2)
